claim: ElastiCache serverless uses both port 6379 and port 6380, while node-based clusters use port 6379 for Valkey and Redis OSS commands. Many clients establish connections to both ports even if not actively using Read From Replica, so you need to make port 6380 accessible even if you do not intend to use Read From Replica.
